detail.command:
set -e
xcodegen generate
xcodebuild -project Delete2.xcodeproj -scheme Delete2 -configuration Debug -destination 'id=00008130-0001252130E1401C' -derivedDataPath .build-device -allowProvisioningUpdates build
APP_PATH=$(find .build-device/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos -maxdepth 1 -name '*.app' -print -quit)
test -n "$APP_PATH"
xcrun devicectl device install app --device 102310B0-86E3-5699-9244-D14A10CED058 "$APP_PATH"
xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 102310B0-86E3-5699-9244-D14A10CED058 pro.cornel.Delete2
printf '%s\n' "APP_PATH=$APP_PATH"
git status --short
